图表引出.w: did not move in a uniform direction
图表引出.meaning: 并未朝着相同方向变化
图表引出.en: The bar chart shows that the population figures associated with urban and rural areas did not move in a uniform direction from 1990 to 2010.
图表引出.cn: 该柱状图表明，1990 至 2010 年间城乡人口数量并未朝着相同方向变化。

图表引出.w: presents an uneven distribution among the perceived benefits of …
图表引出.meaning: 呈现了人们对……各项益处的看法分布
图表引出.en: The bar chart presents an uneven distribution among the perceived benefits of children's outdoor activities.

图表引出.w: The table presents an uneven distribution among…
图表引出.meaning: 该表格呈现了……之间的不均衡分布
图表引出.en: The table presents an uneven distribution among the age groups associated with job satisfaction.
图表引出.cn: 该表格呈现了各年龄段在工作满意度上的不均衡分布。

图表引出.w: This pie chart presents an uneven distribution among…
图表引出.meaning: 该饼图呈现了……之间的不均衡分布
图表引出.en: The pie chart presents an uneven distribution among the categories associated with Spring Festival spending.
图表引出.cn: 该饼图呈现了春节各项花销之间的不均衡分布。

上升趋势.en: The line chart shows that the figures associated with museums and museum visitors rose steadily from 2013 to 2015.
上升趋势.cn: 该折线图表明，2013 至 2015 年间博物馆数量与参观人数的数据均持续上升。

上升趋势.w: rose steadily during the periods presented
上升趋势.meaning: 在相应时期内持续上升
上升趋势.en: The bar chart shows that the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs rose steadily during the periods presented.
上升趋势.cn: 该柱状图表明，大学生兼职比例在相应时期内持续上升。

上升趋势.en: The upward trend stems from students' growing wish to gain practical experience.
上升趋势.cn: 这一上升趋势源于学生获取实践经验意愿的增强。

上升趋势.en: Subscriptions in developing countries climbed from 0.5 billion in 2000 to 4 billion in 2008, while those in developed countries rose from 0.7 billion to 1 billion over the same span.
Although both moved in the same direction, the growth of museums slowed down in 2014 while visits maintained a dynamic momentum.
上升趋势.cn: 二者虽同向变动，但博物馆数量的增长在 2014 年放缓，而参观人数保持了强劲势头。

上升趋势.en: By contrast, the proportion of graduates starting a business rose slightly, from 1.3% to 2.6%.
The rate climbed from 67.77% in the first year to 88.24% in the final year, and the biggest increase occurred in the graduation year, when the figure was 16% higher than a year earlier.
上升趋势.cn: 比例从大一的 67.77% 升至大四的 88.24%，其中增幅最大的是毕业那年，比上年高出 16%。

幅度·速度.w: expanded their share by nearly the same margin
幅度·速度.en: Chinese brands climbed from a modest share to the leading position, while Japanese brands fell by nearly 10 percentage points and lost their top place.
In developing countries, the mobile-phone market had not yet reached saturation, and given the enormous population, the number of potential customers was huge.

幅度·速度.w: left little room for further growth
幅度·速度.meaning: 几乎没有进一步增长的空间
幅度·速度.en: In developed countries, by contrast, a saturated market left little room for further growth.

幅度·速度.w: marked a watershed when the growth accelerated
幅度·速度.en: Notably, the year 2016 marked a watershed, when the growth accelerated considerably.
幅度·速度.cn: 值得注意的是，2016 年是转折点，增速明显加快。

幅度·速度.w: the pace of growth differed sharply
幅度·速度.en: Although the two moved in the same direction, the pace of growth differed sharply.
Although both moved in the same direction, the growth in rural areas was particularly striking.
幅度·速度.cn: 二者虽同向变动，但农村地区的增长尤为显著。

占比·分布.w: accounts for the largest share, at …%
占比·分布.en: Employees above 50 account for the largest share of satisfaction, at 40%.
占比·分布.cn: 50 岁以上员工满意度占比最大，达 40%。
variants: accounts for the largest share, at …%
account for the largest share, at …%

占比·分布.en: Exercising with friends follows closely, representing 47.7%, while working out with family members accounts for 23.9%.
占比·分布.cn: 与朋友一起锻炼紧随其后，占 47.7%，与家人一起锻炼占 23.9%。

占比·分布.w: make up relatively small proportions of …
占比·分布.en: In contrast, other purposes make up a relatively small proportion of 2.2%.
占比·分布.cn: 相比之下，其他目的占比很小，仅 2.2%。
variants: make up a relatively small proportion of …%
make up relatively small proportions of … and …
make up relatively small proportions of …% and …% respectively
make up relatively small proportions of …, respectively
make up relatively small proportions of …, … and … respectively

占比·分布.w: form the middle group, representing …% and …% respectively
占比·分布.meaning: 处于中间位置，分别占……% 和……%
占比·分布.en: Killing time and obtaining information form the middle group, representing 21.3% and 17.0% respectively.
占比·分布.cn: 消磨时间与获取信息处于中间位置，分别占 21.3% 和 17.0%。

占比·分布.w: account for the largest share, together making up …% of the total
占比·分布.meaning: 占比最大，合计达总额的……%
占比·分布.en: Traveling, gift giving and dinners with friends or relatives account for the largest share, together making up 80% of the total.
占比·分布.cn: 旅行、送礼以及与亲友聚餐占比最大，合计达总额的 80%。

占比·分布.w: accounts for the largest share, at slightly over half of the respondents
占比·分布.meaning: 占比最大，略超受访者半数
占比·分布.en: Working out alone accounts for the largest share, at slightly over half of the respondents.
占比·分布.cn: 独自锻炼占比最大，略超受访者半数。

占比·分布.en: The middle group, those aged 41 to 50, represents the lowest level, with none of them satisfied and 64% expressing dissatisfaction.
占比·分布.cn: 41 至 50 岁的中间组水平最低，无人满意，64% 表示不满。

升降对比·转折.meaning: 相比之下（用于转折对比）
升降对比·转折.en: By contrast, American brands held steady, with only a slight increase.

升降对比·转折.w: climbed from … to …, while … declined from … to …
升降对比·转折.en: The urban population climbed from 300 million to 670 million, while the rural population declined from 820 million to 680 million over the same span.
升降对比·转折.cn: 城镇人口从 3 亿攀升至 6.7 亿，而农村人口在同一时期从 8.2 亿降至 6.8 亿。

升降对比·转折.w: declined from … to …, while … climbed from … to …
升降对比·转折.en: The share of those entering employment declined from 68.1% to 60.7%, while the share of those pursuing further education climbed from 26.3% to 34.0%.

升降对比·转折.w: were displaced from their leading position
升降对比·转折.en: Chinese brands climbed from a modest share to the leading position, while Japanese brands fell by nearly 10 percentage points and lost their top place.

原因·背景.w: a natural consequence of changing parenting ideas
原因·背景.meaning: 育儿观念变化的自然结果
原因·背景.en: Seen in this light, the pattern of opinions is a natural consequence of changing parenting ideas.

原因·背景.w: a natural consequence of social life
原因·背景.meaning: 社会生活变化的自然结果
原因·背景.en: Seen in this light, the pattern of spending is no coincidence but a natural consequence of social life.
原因·背景.cn: 由此可见，这一消费结构并非偶然，而是社会生活变化的自然结果。

原因·背景.w: a shift in graduates’ view of post-university life
原因·背景.meaning: 毕业生对毕业后生活看法的转变
原因·背景.en: The data reflects a shift in graduates' view of post-university life.
To be specific, as livestreaming e-commerce takes off, people are more inclined to purchase online, thereby giving impetus to the delivery business.
原因·背景.cn: 具体而言，随着直播电商兴起，人们更倾向线上购物，从而推动快递业务发展。

原因·背景.en: On the one hand, Chinese auto producers have narrowed the technology gap between themselves and foreign competitors and have cleverly adjusted their promotion strategies.

原因·背景.w: on account of flexibility and convenience
原因·背景.en: People prefer to exercise alone primarily on account of flexibility and convenience.
原因·背景.cn: 人们偏好独自锻炼，主要出于灵活与便利。

原因·背景.en: The 41-to-50 group, less energetic than the younger crowd and less established than older professionals, often reaches a career plateau, and the consequent sense of powerlessness reduces them to deep dissatisfaction.
原因·背景.cn: 41 至 50 岁组比年轻人精力不足、比年长者资历尚浅，往往进入职业平台期，随之而来的无力感使他们深感不满。

原因·背景.en: Moreover, the awareness of self-improvement has spread widely among university students who wish to stay competitive in the job market.
原因·背景.cn: 此外，希望在就业市场保持竞争力的学生中，自我提升意识已广泛传播。

原因·背景.en: Seen in this light, the change in priorities is a natural consequence of social life.

The 41-to-50 group, less energetic than the younger crowd and less established than older professionals, often reaches a career plateau, and the consequent sense of powerlessness reduces them to deep dissatisfaction.
原因·背景.cn: 41 至 50 岁组比年轻人精力不足、比年长者资历尚浅，往往进入职业平台期，随之而来的无力感使他们深感不满。

原因·背景.w: the joint effects of urbanization and unequal economic opportunities
原因·背景.meaning: 城镇化与经济机会不均的共同作用
原因·背景.en: The narrowing gap results from the joint effects of urbanization and unequal economic opportunities.
原因·背景.cn: 差距的缩小源于城镇化与经济机会不均的共同作用。

原因·背景.w: the national endeavour in cultural undertakings
原因·背景.meaning: 国家在文化事业上的努力
原因·背景.en: Firstly, thanks to the national endeavour in cultural undertakings, numerous museums have been built and opened free to the public.
原因·背景.cn: 首先，得益于国家在文化事业上的努力，大量博物馆建成并向公众免费开放。

原因·背景.en: On the one hand, with the prosperity of tourism, college students who have ample time and curiosity are lured to explore the outside world.

意义·价值.w: a low-intensity activity suitable for the elderly
意义·价值.meaning: 适合老年人的低强度活动
意义·价值.en: Secondly, walking is a low-intensity activity suitable for most elderly people.
On the other hand, growing academic pressure makes a journey an ideal way to recharge.
Besides, although planting flowers, reading and playing chess occupy smaller shares, they still enrich the daily life of those who take them up.
Most spending is used to maintain or facilitate interpersonal relationships.
意义·价值.cn: 大部分开支用于维系或增进人际关系。

意义·价值.w: gain easy and fast access to professional advice
意义·价值.meaning: 便捷快速地获得专业建议
意义·价值.en: Secondly, the digitalization of many health services, such as online consultation and AI diagnosis, has enabled residents to gain easy and fast access to professional advice.
意义·价值.cn: 其次，在线问诊、AI 诊断等健康服务的数字化，使居民能够便捷快速地获得专业建议。

意义·价值.en: The upward trend stems from students' growing wish to gain practical experience.
意义·价值.cn: 这一上升趋势源于学生获取实践经验意愿的增强。

意义·价值.w: regard … as a vivid classroom where children learn through discovery
意义·价值.meaning: 把……视为孩子通过探索来学习的生动课堂
意义·价值.en: On the one hand, the high value placed on curiosity and observation suggests that parents increasingly regard the outdoor world as a vivid classroom where children learn through discovery.
On the other hand, an increasing number of restaurants with similar prices are available, so distinctive features have become the key to standing out.
Moreover, as living standards improve, the public demand increasingly varied spiritual nourishment, and visiting museums has therefore become a willing choice for more people.
意义·价值.cn: 此外，随着生活水平提高，公众对多样化精神食粮的需求上升，参观博物馆因而成为更多人的自愿选择。

建议·展望.w: boosted the popularity of doing workouts at home
建议·展望.meaning: 推动了居家锻炼的流行
建议·展望.en: Furthermore, a wide range of fitness videos, apps and games have boosted the popularity of doing workouts at home.
建议·展望.cn: 此外，大量健身视频、应用与游戏也推动了居家独自锻炼的流行。

建议·展望.en: Relevant authorities should channel more resources into the countryside and create favorable conditions for local employment, so that rural residents can also benefit from national progress.
建议·展望.cn: 有关部门应向农村倾斜更多资源，为本地就业创造有利条件，让农村居民也能从国家发展中获益。

建议·展望.w: give impetus to the delivery business
建议·展望.en: The bar chart shows that the express delivery volumes associated with the whole country and rural areas rose steadily from 2018 to 2020.
建议·展望.cn: 该柱状图表明，2018 至 2020 年间全国与农村的快递业务量均持续上升。

建议·展望.w: keep pace with the public demand
建议·展望.en: Firstly, thanks to the national endeavour in cultural undertakings, numerous museums have been built and opened free to the public.
建议·展望.cn: 首先，得益于国家在文化事业上的努力，大量博物馆建成并向公众免费开放。

建议·展望.en: However, we should not go to extremes.
In the twenty years, urban sprawl transformed millions of peasants into city residents, and many more chose to leave their hometowns on their own initiative.
建议·展望.cn: 二十年间，城市扩张使数百万农民被动转为城镇居民，更多人则主动离开家乡。

建议·展望.w: paves the way for their career development
建议·展望.en: Firstly, the practical knowledge offered by the course enables students to better understand their interests and paves the way for their career development.
Moreover, the government has made sustained efforts to improve infrastructure in the countryside, which paves the way for courier services to extend to the vast rural markets.
建议·展望.cn: 此外，政府持续改善农村基础设施，为快递服务延伸到广阔的农村市场铺平了道路。

建议·展望.en: For physical exercise to bring lasting benefits, individuals should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, while relevant authorities should provide more public sports facilities.
建议·展望.cn: 要使体育锻炼带来长久收益，个人应结合自身情况作出理性选择，有关部门也应提供更多公共体育设施。

建议·展望.en: On the one hand, as the job market becomes increasingly competitive, a higher degree is widely regarded as a way of securing an advantage.

建议·展望.w: stay competitive in the job market
建议·展望.meaning: 在就业市场中保持竞争力
建议·展望.en: Moreover, the awareness of self-improvement has spread widely among university students who wish to stay competitive in the job market.
建议·展望.cn: 此外，希望在就业市场保持竞争力的学生中，自我提升意识已广泛传播。

建议·展望.w: strike a balance between work and study
建议·展望.en: Universities should provide more internship channels, while students should strike a balance between work and study in light of their own circumstances.
建议·展望.cn: 高校应提供更多实习渠道，学生也应结合自身情况平衡好学业与工作。

主题词·术语.en: Moreover, hands-on experience is highly valued in today's job market, which encourages students to focus on applicable skills.
The line chart shows that the health literacy rate of Chinese residents rose steadily from 2012 to 2021.
主题词·术语.cn: 该折线图表明，2012 至 2021 年间中国居民健康素养水平持续上升。

主题词·术语.en: On the one hand, as per capita disposable income has risen, more people can afford to dine out, and it is natural that they care more about high-quality enjoyment than about price.
